Team — quick sync: finance needs a certified list of EMEA/APAC commit opportunities by EOD Friday (local EMEA close). Goal is to reduce the number of "orphan" opps we carry into close and give finance a clean snapshot for revenue recognition planning.

Please do the following today:

- Orphans: flag any opportunity without a clear owner; I attached a working export for reference.

I'll aggregate and push the cleaned snapshot to Finance on Monday morning (APAC) / Friday EOD (EMEA). If you can't confirm by Thursday EOD please escalate to me so we can reassign.
